chunks: One of our companions, from Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Salih al-Taymuli, from Ayub ibn Nuh, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from a man, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

A man came to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) and said, 'O Messenger of Allah! With me is the most highly dowered of the Arabs, and I would love for you to accept her, and she is my daughter.' He said, 'I have accepted her.' He said, 'So (there is) another, O Messenger of Allah!' He said, 'And what is she?' He said, 'Hardship has not struck her forehead at all.' He said, 'There is no need for me regarding her, but marry her to Jilbeeb.'

So the legs of the man failed from what entered into him. Then he went to her mother and informed her of the news, so what entered her was similar to what had entered him. So the girl heard his speech and saw what had entered her father, so she said to them, 'Be pleased for me with whatever Allah and His Messenger are pleased with for me.'

So that consoled both of them, and her father came to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) and informed him of the news. So the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said, 'I have made her dowry to be Paradise.'
And Safwan added in it, saying, 'So Jilbeeb died from her, and her dowry reached one hundred thousand dirhams after him.'

key_terms.مَهِيرَةُ الْعَرَبِ: The most highly dowered of the Arabs

ai.seo_question: What is the story of the Prophet's daughter or the highly dowered woman who was married to Jilbeeb?
ai.summary: This narration from *Al-Kafi* illustrates the Prophet’s (peace be upon him) discernment in marriage, rejecting a wealthy but potentially unsuitable match in favor of Jilbeeb, whose name implies nobility or piety. The daughter’s acceptance of her father’s choice with the phrase 'Be pleased with what Allah and His Messenger are pleased with' highlights the Shia emphasis on *rida* (contentment) with divine decree in familial matters. The concluding statement that her *mahr* (dowry) became Paradise underscores the spiritual valuation of marital compatibility over material wealth.

en.hubeali:
One of our companions, from Ali Bin Al Husayn Bin Salih Al Taymuly, from Ayoub Bin Nuh, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from a man, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘A man came over to the Prophet<sup>saww</sup>, so he said, ‘O Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>! With me is a woman of the highest dower of the Arabs, and I would love it if you<sup>saww</sup> were to accept her, and she is my daughter’. So he<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘I<sup>saww</sup> have accepted her’. He said, ‘So (I have) another, O Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>!’. He<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘And what is she?’ He said, ‘She has not been struck upon her forehead at all (with any hardship)’. He<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘There is no need for me regarding her, but marry her to Jilbeeb’.

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So the legs of the man failed from what entered into him. Then her mother came over, so he informed her of the news, so there entered into her similar to what had entered into him. So the girl heard his speech and saw what had entered into her parents, so she said to them, ‘Be pleased for me with whatever Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and His<sup>azwj</sup> Rasool<sup>saww</sup> are pleased with for me’.

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So that consoled both of them, and her father came over to the Prophet<sup>saww</sup> and informed him<sup>saww</sup> of the news. So Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘I<sup>saww</sup> have made her dowry to be the Paradise’.
And Safwan (a narrator) has an increased in it saying, ‘So Jilbeeb died from her and her dower reached one hundred thousand Dirhams’.
en.sarwar: 2. Certain persons of our people have narrated from Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Salih al-Taymuliy from Ayyub ibn Nuh from Muhammad ibn Sinan from a man who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that

once a man came to the Holy Prophet, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, and said, ‘O Messenger of Allah, I have Mahirah al-‘Arab (the girl with highest amount of dower among Arabs); will you accept her and she is my daughter?’ He (the Messenger of Allah) replied, ‘I accept her.’ The man said, ‘Another (characteristic) O Messenger of Allah.’ He (the Messenger of Allah) asked, ‘What is that?’ He said, ‘She has never suffered any hardships at all.’ He (the Messenger of Allah) said, ‘I do not need her but give her in marriage to Jilbib.’

He (the Imam) said, ‘Both legs of the man almost failed because of the shock, then her mother came and when she was informed she also felt the same condition as her father. When the girl heard the words and saw the condition her parents were in, she said to them, ‘Please be happy for me with what Allah and His Messenger have chosen for me.’

He (the Imam) said, ‘What the girl said comforted her parents. Her father came to the Holy Prophet, and informed him of her words. The Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, said, ‘I have made paradise for her mahr (dower).’
Safwan has added, ‘Her husband (Jilbib) died and her mahr reached one hundred thousand dirham.’”
